value.body: A business development executive looks for new customers or partners and turns interest into deals. Employers include ed-tech, SaaS, services, media and manufacturing companies, often in B2B settings. A typical day involves calls and emails to prospects, demos or meetings, proposal preparation and updating a CRM.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: Any graduate; BBA Marketing, B.Com and BMS are common

items.label: Common tools
items.value: CRM software, email outreach tools, LinkedIn, Excel

items.label: B.B.A. enrolment (all specialisations)
items.note: Students across all BBA years, not only marketing
items.source: AISHE 2023-24, Table 11 (programme-wise enrolment, all modes, actual responses)

items.label: Indian tech industry revenue (NASSCOM)
items.note: Estimate; one of many sectors that hire business development staff

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Companies hire freshers through campus placement, job portals and walk-ins, usually with a sales-aptitude or role-play round. Clear spoken English and the local language help in client calls.

value.title: At a glance
items: Pay is often split into a fixed part and targets-based incentives.
Next roles: senior BDE, key account manager, business development manager.
Targets are pressured; turnover in some sectors is high.
